m01:room.title: The Thermal Code Annex

m02:room.title: The Air Logic Gallery
m02:room.job: Find out why one reading produced two orders.

m03:room.title: The Mobility Test Hall
m03:room.job: Find out whether Rover Three's loop can end.

m04:room.title: The Regression Vault
m04:room.job: Find out whether three systems are failing or one shared part is.

m05:room.title: The Object Identity Workshop
m05:room.job: Find out which object the patch has been raising.

m06:room.title: The Packet Parsing Bay
m06:room.job: Find out where a character goes missing between the packet and the screen.

m07:room.title: The Habitat Sensor Gallery

m08:room.title: The Incident Archive Room
m08:room.job: Find out what the cleanup loop does to the alert list while it runs.

m09:room.title: The Ice Route Mapping Room
m09:room.job: Find out which cell the rover's copy of the survey grid actually wrote.

m10:room.title: The Frequency Search Deck
m10:room.job: Find which search reaches the rescue channel inside the pass.

m11:room.title: The Controller Class Lab
m11:room.job: Find out whether two controllers share one alarm.

m12:room.title: The Rescue Queue Studio
m12:room.job: Find out what fixes the order of two records carrying the same priority.

m13:room.title: The Relay Route Lab
m13:room.job: Find out how a planner that calls itself decides when to stop.

m14:room.title: The Rollback Proving Room

m15:room.title: The Recovery Control Room
m15:room.job: Settle which build the staged release can carry to every controller.
